evidence: Workbook #16: 'The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.' Skill quality-checks.md ### 16: /app holds only .gitkeep; no starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI in the agent image; nothing under /instructions reproduces criterion text. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e...67d1); build context is environment/ only, with COPY limited to instructions/ and assets/; no COPY of solution/ or tests/. (2) Actual build (docker build of task/environment, image tagged qc-r7-row16-env:tmp, sha256:ecdf083b..., removed afterwards along with its --rm container): /app contains only .git and an empty .gitkeep; git ls-files = .gitkeep; one commit 'Initialize task workspace'. /instructions holds only conversations.md, integration.md, walls-and-retention.md; /assets holds only seed_data.json (5903 bytes). find / -xdev for server.js, app.js, *.toml, app_context.md, solve.sh outside /usr and /proc returned nothing. (3) environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 b256f85e...bf8, matching the raw-evidence index and identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json) is raw input only: accounts, three matters with timer_days, walled lists, raw messages with stored times/parent/hold/versions, read_up_to. It contains no precomputed outcome (it does not mark which messages a 7-day timer has already expired, e.g. K-1 at 2026-05-01 on M-11, which the agent must derive), no schema, routes, or UI. (4) The /instructions notes are product prose (behaviour of walls, timers, holds, transcripts, replies, formatting, run contract). Grep of environment/ for criteri|rubric|judge|JUDGE-|fails if|score|grader|verifier|playwright|solution|golden: zero matches. A 10-word n-gram overlap scan of instruction.md + /instructions against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md found zero shared 10-grams with any judge.toml or prompt.md; the only overlaps (3) are with tests/app_context.md and are the account table (emails/names/roles), which is input data, not criterion text. Counterexample attempts: an agent cannot copy a finished app because none exists in the image; a broken app cannot pass by echoing instruction text since criteria use unseen JUDGE- tokens and verifier-side steps; a conforming alternative is not disadvantaged because nothing in the image constrains structure (no route list or schema).
